thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks rise premarket, led by Cisco's surge - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks rise premarket, led by Cisco's surge - MarketWatch
text: Shares of all 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.03% components rose in premarket trade Thursday, led by a 7.9% surge in Cisco Systems Inc.'s stock CSCO, +2.09% The gains come as Dow futures YMH8, +0.86% jumped 185 points, adding to the Dow's 1,033-point gain over the past four sessions. Among shares of other more-active movers ahead of Thursday's open, Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.84% climbed 1.2%, General Electric Co. GE, +1.57% gained 0.4% and Intel Corp. INTC, +2.07% tacked on 0.3%. Cisco's stock surge comes after the networking company reported late Wednesday fiscal second-quarter results that beat expectations, provided an upbeat outlook for the current quarter and raised its dividend.
